summary: Verified iteration-119 code-review fixes on Brightluxx (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration119_review_fixes.py (29 tests, 28 pass). Confirmed: CATEGORY_PROMPTS now defined and both /api/admin/images/categories and /api/admin/images/preview-prompt/{slug} return 200 with valid data; image_management.py uses hashlib.sha256 with zero md5 references; zero bare 'except:' remaining anywhere in /app/backend (grepped whole backend, not just the 5 named routes); OLD_SECRET and ADMIN_PASSWORD now read from os.environ with no hardcoded credential defaults. Frontend: DOMPurify imported and applied on every dangerouslySetInnerHTML in src (BlogPost, AuraChat, AdminSiteSettings) - verified live in browser that an injected <script>, img onerror and javascript: href in the google_map embed are all stripped while the Google Maps <iframe> (with allowfullscreen/loading) survives, and window.__xss was never set. Contact form submits end-to-end (success panel shown), BlogPost renders sanitized rich HTML (26.5KB), AURA chat streams a markdown answer with bold/links rendered - all three pages with 0 JS/page errors. Admin login works; AdminLeads detail drawer shows geo (city/region/country_name + ISP) and colour-coded Spam Score. Regression: re-ran iteration_116 + iteration_118 suites -> 78/78 pass (the previously failing spam-score clamp test now passes).

minor.issue: MongoDB `_id` is exposed in every lead object (serialize_doc stringifies _id instead of removing it). Pre-existing, affects all admin_crud endpoints using serialize_doc. Also some legacy lead docs have id=null.

Anti-spam/validation rejections return HTTP 422 (raised via HTTPException 422?) rather than 400 for business-rule failures (disposable email, spam content). Semantically these are 400-class client errors; only noting for API consistency, not a functional break.

ui_bugs.issue: React DOM-nesting console errors on /admin/leads: '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>/<tr>/<select>/<option> - This will cause a hydration error' (4 occurrences). Cosmetic/console-only, table renders fine, but invalid HTML nesting should be cleaned up.

action_items: Exclude MongoDB `_id` in serialize_doc (or pop it) so /api/admin/leads and other admin_crud responses stop leaking ObjectId.
Optional: fix invalid <span> nesting inside <tbody>/<tr>/<select> in AdminLeads/AdminLayout to clear React hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSiteSettings DOMPurify config allows <iframe> globally via ADD_TAGS; consider also constraining src with a hostname allowlist (google.com/maps) since an admin-editable field with arbitrary iframe src still permits framing untrusted origins.
serialize_doc converts _id to a string rather than dropping it - single-point fix removes the ObjectId leak across all admin CRUD routes.

success_rate.backend: 97% (28/29 new tests; 78/78 regression tests from iter 116+118)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (contact submit, blog render, AURA chat, admin login, leads geo drawer, site-settings XSS sanitization)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted transient leads prefixed TEST_i119 / TEST_i119ui (Mongo cleanup executed, 0 residual).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration119_review_fixes.py. It includes source-level guards (no bare except in routes, DOMPurify on every dangerouslySetInnerHTML, secrets from env, sha256 not md5) plus live API tests. One intentionally failing test remains: test_admin_leads_no_mongo_object_id - it documents the _id leak and should pass once serialize_doc is fixed. Note /api/leads returns 422 (not 400) for anti-spam rejections. Site Settings admin route is /admin/site-settings (NOT /admin/settings, which is Account/Security). Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' for Playwright navigation - 'networkidle' never settles on this site.
rca_of_the_issue: No new defects introduced by this fix iteration. The only failing assertion (_id in admin leads payload) is pre-existing: routes/admin_crud.py:183 maps documents through serialize_doc(), which converts ObjectId to str instead of removing the _id key, so every admin listing includes the internal Mongo id.
